ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)
notes: SENT does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. The sensor ID, frame format, tick time, and slow-channel content are sensor configuration (often factory-programmed and partly discoverable via the slow serial message); an implementation may back these with non-volatile storage, but the standard only requires the frame format be consistent and the ID be conveyable over the slow channel.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: A device ID conveyed in the Short/Enhanced serial message; typically factory-programmed, not a protocol-fixed OTP concept.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.field: Frame format (data nibble count, channel format)
otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Fixed for a given sensor; programmed at manufacture.
The nominal tick time and pause-pulse setting.
